mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO user_ratings (user_id, rating, matches_played, wins, losses, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{rating}, 0, 0, 0, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE user_ratings SET rating = #{rating}, matches_played = matches_played + 1, wins = wins + #{winInc}, losses = losses + #{lossInc}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT r.user_id, r.rating, r.matches_played, r.wins, r.losses, r.created_at, r.updated_at, u.nickname, u.avatar_url, u.username, (CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(u.role, '')) = 'ADMIN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_admin FROM user_ratings r INNER JOIN users u ON u.id = r.user_id WHERE u.status = 1 ORDER BY r.rating DESC, r.user_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) + 1 FROM user_ratings r INNER JOIN users u ON u.id = r.user_id WHERE u.status = 1 AND ( r.rating > #{rating} OR (r.rating = #{rating} AND r.user_id < #{userId}) )
